app.title: SincronizzaFoto - Android photo & file sync
app.subtitle: Copy photos, videos and files from your Android phone to your PC. Only new files are copied.
main.rules_hint: Each rule copies one folder of the phone to one folder of the PC. Switch a rule off to skip it.
main.phone_ready: Phone ready. Press Start copy to copy what is new.
main.empty_text: A rule tells the program which folder of the phone to copy and where to save it. The quick setup creates the common ones for you.
reorg.title: Tidy up existing files
reorg.intro: Moves the files already copied into the structure this rule now uses, so the next sync recognizes them. Nothing is deleted, nothing is overwritten and nothing is copied from the phone. Only the files in the folder itself and in year or month folders are considered; any other subfolder is left alone.

org.flat.title: Everything in one folder (like on the phone)
org.flat.desc: All files go straight into the destination folder, with no subfolders - the same look as on the phone. Best if you just want a copy of everything.
org.year.title: One folder per year
org.year.desc: Files are sorted into folders such as 2025 and 2026, using the date of the photo. Good for big libraries without too many folders.
org.yearMonth.title: One folder per month
org.yearMonth.desc: Folders such as 2026-11. The date comes from the file name (IMG_20261117_...) or, if there is none, from the file's modified date. Good to browse by date.
org.mirror.title: Keep the phone's subfolders
org.mirror.desc: Recreates the same subfolders as on the phone (needs 'Also copy the subfolders'). Good for Download, Documents or WhatsApp (Sent, ...).
editor.name: 1. Name of the rule
editor.name_hint: Anything you like, for example 'Camera' or 'WhatsApp photos'. It is only shown in the list.
editor.phone_hint: Path inside the phone's internal storage, for example DCIM\Camera. Use 'Browse phone...' to pick it from the phone (connect it first), or choose a common one from the list.
editor.browse_dest: Choose the folder where the files will be saved
editor.dest_hint: The folder is created if it does not exist. Folders inside your user folder are stored as %USERPROFILE%\... so the rules also work on a friend's PC.
editor.ext_hint: For example: pdf, zip, apk. Leave empty if the types above are enough.
editor.exclude_hint: Separate with commas. A name (like .thumbnails) skips every folder with that name, at any depth; a path (like Sent\Private) skips only that folder. Everything inside a skipped folder is ignored.
editor.subfolders_hint: Switch it on if the phone folder contains other folders you want too (for example Download or WhatsApp 'Sent'). Leave it off for the camera.

qs.title: Quick setup
qs.intro: Choose what you want to copy and one base folder on your PC. A rule is created for each choice, saving into its own subfolder of the base folder. You can change everything later with the pencil icon of each rule.
qs.base_hint: For example D:\Phone - each choice below gets its own folder inside it (Camera, Screenshots...).
qs.err_none: Tick at least one item to copy.

Made by GAle & Claude (Anthropic)

GAle - the idea, the Xiaomi Mi 9T, the testing and endless patience.
Claude - the code, the bugs and (eventually) the bug fixes.

No phones were harmed. Several duplicates were.

Thank you to everyone who reports a bug or sends a pull request!
